meta.title: Developer API
meta.description: Three Marks public API: WN8 and recent periods, player history, tank statistics, marks of excellence thresholds and clans. Free key, SDK and webhooks.

header.title: Developer API
header.lead: REST API /v1: WN8, player history, tank statistics, marks of excellence thresholds, clans and sessions.

quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.description: A key, the SDK and one request. Responses are JSON, errors carry a machine-readable code.

key.title: Create a key
key.text: Sign in and create a key in the <link>developer dashboard</link>. The secret is shown once.

install.title: Install the SDK
install.text: bun add @otmetki/sdk — types, retries and webhook verification. From any other language, send the X-API-Key header.

request.title: Send a request
request.text: A nickname or an account id returns a summary with WN8, EFF, Bronya Index and recent periods.

reference.title: API reference
reference.description: Every /v1 endpoint with parameters, response schemas and request samples, in the interactive reference on the API server.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: The server sends a POST to your URL when a followed player earns a mark, finishes a session or a clan roster changes.

events.markGained: A player earned a new mark of excellence. Fires for the players and clans in the webhook filter.
events.sessionEnded: A player finished a play session: battles, wins, average damage and session WN8.
events.clanMemberChanged: A clan roster changed: someone joined, left or got a new role.

headers.signature: Space-separated signatures, each “v1,” followed by base64: HMAC-SHA256 over “id.timestamp.body”, keyed with the base64-decoded part of the secret after the whsec_ prefix, per the Standard Webhooks spec.
headers.timestamp: Send time in Unix seconds. Part of the signature.
headers.event: Event name, same as the event field.
headers.delivery: Delivery id: part of the signature, use it for idempotency.

notes.tolerance: Reject deliveries older than {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} — it guards against replays.
notes.retries: A failed delivery is retried with growing backoff: up to {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} in total.
notes.disable: After {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in a row the webhook is switched off; turn it back on in the dashboard.

tiers.title: Limits
tiers.description: The API is free for everyone. A Plus subscription raises your personal limits, and open free community projects get higher limits on request.

access.label: How to get it
access.plus: With a Plus subscription, for personal non-commercial use
access.community: Free for open free projects — contact us

items.personal: Plus limits are for personal non-commercial use: your own bots, widgets and scripts.
items.resale: Reselling access to our API or putting its data behind a paywall is forbidden.
items.lesta: Part of the data comes from the Lesta API, so Lesta Games’ terms apply too: credit the data source and do not use it commercially.
